title: AHR Activation Mediates Sodium Pentachlorophenol-Induced Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Cardiomyocyte Apoptosis through Oxidative Stress.
authors: Chao, Lidong; Wu, Ruoning; Zhang, Yudi; Luo, Jilong; Gao, Xue-Jiao
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究五氯酚钠通过AHR/CYP1A1/ROS轴致心肌细胞凋亡，虽含分子对接但核心为毒理学通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Sodium pentachlorophenol (PCP-Na) is a persistent halogenated aromatic compound with poorly understood cardiotoxicity. This study investigated the underlying mechanisms using mouse models and HL-1 cardiomyocytes, integrating network toxicology, molecular docking, and targeted interventions with the AHR inhibitor CH223191, the antioxidant N-acetylcysteine (NAC), and the CYP1A1 inhibitor alpha-naphthoflavone (ANF). Findings demonstrate that PCP-Na promotes AHR nuclear translocation and dose-dependently activates the downstream target gene CYP1A1. This AHR/CYP1A1/ROS signaling axis triggers excessive oxidative stress, subsequently leading to mitochondrial dynamic imbalance, impaired ATP production, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis. By systematically elucidating these molecular pathways, this study highlights AHR as a direct target of PCP-Na and provides a critical theoretical basis for the safety assessment of agricultural and environmental matrices contaminated with persistent organic pollutants. These results offer novel insights into the protective potential of AHR/CYP1A1 inhibitors against halogenated contaminant-induced cardiac injury.
abstract_zh: 五氯苯酚钠（PCP-Na）是一种持久性卤代芳香族化合物，其心脏毒性机制尚不明确。本研究利用小鼠模型和HL-1心肌细胞，整合网络毒理学、分子对接以及针对AHR抑制剂CH223191、抗氧化剂N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）和CYP1A1抑制剂α-萘黄酮（ANF）的靶向干预，探讨了其潜在机制。研究结果表明，PCP-Na促进AHR核转位，并剂量依赖性地激活下游靶基因CYP1A1。该AHR/CYP1A1/ROS信号轴引发过度氧化应激，进而导致线粒体动态失衡、ATP产生受损及心肌细胞凋亡。通过系统阐明这些分子通路，本研究强调AHR是PCP-Na的直接靶点，并为受持久性有机污染物污染的农业和环境基质的安全性评估提供了关键理论基础。这些结果为AHR/CYP1A1抑制剂在卤代污染物诱导的心脏损伤中的保护潜力提供了新见解。
